articles.title: ZDI-26-849: Microsoft Qlib RestrictedUnpickler Deserialization of Untrusted Data Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
articles.summary: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Microsoft Qlib. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The ZDI has assigned a CVSS rating of 7.8.

articles.title: CVE-2026-120247 — CVSS 5.5
articles.summary: FFmpeg 2.3 through 9.0.2 contains a use of uninitialized resource vulnerability in the Huffyuv decoder that allows attackers to leak heap memory into decoded pixels via short packed-BGR bitstreams. Attackers can craft a Huffyuv BGR24/BGRA video whose entropy data ends early, causing decode_slice() to add uninitialized s->temp[0] bytes into output frames, exposing heap contents.

articles.title: CVE-2026-120245 — CVSS 5.5
articles.summary: FFmpeg 0.10 through 9.0.2 contains a use of uninitialized resource vulnerability in sunrast_decode_frame() that leaks heap memory when decoding truncated 1-bit and 4-bit paletted Sun Raster images. Attackers can craft a truncated Sun Raster file so the uncleared temporary bitmap is expanded into PAL8 pixels, exposing stale heap contents such as allocator words in decoded output.
